citations.quote: In summary, we have demonstrated that electrode-electrolyte interphase chemistry including ion desolvation and SEI interphase are crucial to the electrochemical properties of the anode at the ultra-high rate and low-temperature extremes via the comparative study of different electrolytes. The THF-based electrolyte enables the commercial HC anode superior rate capability (up to $5 \, Ag^{-1}$ ) and ultra-low-temperature performance (operating stably at $-20^{\circ}C$ ). Kinetic analysis reveals that the remarkable performance is attributed to weakly $Na^{+}$ -solvent desolvation energy and uniform SEI composition achieved in the THF-based electrolyte, which is beneficial to the ion diffusion between the electrolyte–electrode interface and interface stability. This work not only proposes an advanced low-temperature electrolyte, but also provides new insights into the interfacial modulation for next-generation high-rate and low-temperature batteries.

Such excellent cycling stability at low temperature with a high plateau capacity ratio of 70% (below 0.1 V) is rarely reported for sodium-ion batteries previously. According to the above discussions, as illustrated in Figure 4c,d, the electrode–electrolyte interfacial chemistry can be well-modulated in the THF-based electrolyte. Firstly, the $Na^{+}/solvent$ desolvation energy at the interface is very low, which is beneficial to the fast diffusion of $Na^{+}$ between the electrolyte/electrode interface. As a consequence, the commercial HC electrode can demonstrate significantly improved electrochemical properties in THF-based electrolyte in comparison to that in ester-based electrolytes.

citations.quote: Figure 1a and Table S1 (Supporting Information) present the temperature-dependent ionic conductivities of the dilute NaPF $_{6}$ -based ether electrolyte (0.5 M NaPF $_{6}$ in DEGDME, 0.5-P-D), the conventional concentration NaPF $_{6}$ -based ether electrolyte (1.0 M NaPF $_{6}$ in DEGDME, 1.0-P-D), and the commercial ester-based electrolyte (1.0 M NaPF $_{6}$ in the mixture of ethylene carbonate (EC) and dimethyl carbonate (DMC) with a volume ratio of 1:1, 1.0-P-E/M). At 25 °C, 0.5-P-D exhibits a lower ionic conductivity (2.7 mS cm $^{-1}$ ) compared to 1.0-P-D (7.3 mS cm $^{-1}$ ) and 1.0-P-E/M (15.3 mS cm $^{-1}$ ) due to its low salt concentration. However, the higher freezing points (Figure S1, Supporting Information) and steep increase in viscosity at low temperatures (Figures S2 and S3, Supporting Information) lead to decreased fluidity and even solidification of the 1.0-P-D and 1.0-P-E/M electrolytes, resulting in a sharp decline in ionic conductivity below 0 °C. In contrast, 0.5-P-D still exhibits a high value of 0.45 mS cm $^{-1}$ even at -50 °C, enabling considerable Na $^{+}$ migration in the liquid electrolyte at low temperatures. The coordination environments in the 0.5-P-D, 1.0-P-D, and 1.0-P-E/M electrolytes were characterized by Raman spectroscopy (Figure 1b).

citations.quote: The electrochemical performance was tested by CR2032 coin-type. citations.quote: We argue that tuning the solvation structure through introducing solvents with various solvation capability could enhance the solubility of salt by decreasing the system degree of order ( $\Delta S > 0$ ) at low temperature. More specifically, mixing an SS solvent and a WS solvent could have more diverse solvation structure that is capable of altering spontaneously in response to the temperature dropping, and thus, realizing a temperature-adaptive electrolyte (Figure 1b). As a proof of concept, we selected $NaPF_{6}$ as a representative salt to pair with an SS–WS ether solvent mixture. To minimize any potential impact of $\varepsilon$ and DN on the solvation structure, DIG and tetrahydrofuran (THF) solvents with similar $\varepsilon$ (7.23 vs 7.58) and DN (19.5 vs 20.0 kcal mol $^{-1}$ ) values, $^{[15,16]}$ were specifically chosen as the SS and WS solvents, respectively (Table S1, Supporting Information). We first optimized our proposed SS–WS electrolyte formulation to 1.0 M $NaPF_{6}$ dissolved in DIG and THF (2:8 in volume ratio, denoted as NDT, Figure S5, Supporting Information). To compare, 1.0 M $NaPF_{6}$ dissolved in THF (denoted as NT) was chosen as the WS electrolyte and 1.0 M $NaPF_{6}$ dissolved in DIG (denoted as ND) as the SS electrolyte. We then used density functional theory (DFT) calculations to determine the binding energies $(E_{\mathrm{b}})$ of cation–solvent complexes based on the optimized geometrical structures (Figure S1, Supporting Information).

citations.chunk_id: 0073_Yang 等 - 2023 - Entropy-Driven Solvation toward Low-Temperature Sodium-Ion Batteries with Temperature-Adaptive Featu::sec5
citations.quote:
2.4. Toward Practical Viability
We have also examined the compatibility of NDT electrolyte against high-voltage cathode materials for Na-ion batteries. A P2-type $Na_{2/3}Ni_{1/4}Cu_{1/12}Mn_{2/3}O_{2}$ (NNCM) cathode (Figure S16, Supporting Information) was selected as cathode materials to pair with Na metal anode in NDT electrolyte to assembled coin cells. With temperature dropping to -40 and -50 °C, NNCM cathode still achieves quite decent capacities of 79.7 and 72.7 mAh g $^{-1}$ , respectively, corresponding to 88.8% and 81.0% of the capacity delivered at 25 °C (Figure S17a, Supporting Information). Equally importantly, NNCM cathode demonstrated encouraging cycling stability and rate performance in NDT electrolytes under low-temperature operation. For instance, a high-capacity retention of 99.9% over 100 cycles with average columbic efficiency of 99.8% is achieved at -40 °C (Figure S17b, Supporting Information). Even at high rate of 2C, the NNCM cathode still retains reversible capacities of 74.5 mAh g $^{-1}$ (84.2% of that at 0.1 C, see Figure S17c, Supporting Information) at -40 °C. To further verify the feasibility of NDT electrolyte in practical cells, full cells with NNCM cathode and hard carbon anode were fabricated and cycled within 1.50–3.65 V at various temperatures. The NNCM||hard carbon cell delivers an initial discharge capacity of 71.2 mAh g $^{-1}$ at 25 °C, while 70.2% of that capacity can be maintained when the temperature decreases to -40 °C (Figure S18, Supporting Information). In addition, the NNCM||hard carbon full cell exhibits much enhanced cycling stability at -40 °C by featuring a 90.6% capacity retention after 400 cycles (Figure S17d, Supporting Information). Clearly, our testing data demonstrated NDT electrolyte is fully compatible with layered oxide cathode and hard carbon anode, and thus, showed great potential for practical applications in Na-ion battery.

To expand the generality of the concept, we constructed a series of SS–WS electrolyte by selecting linear ethers including 1,2-dimethoxyethane (DME) and triethylene glycol monomethyl ether (Triglyme) as SS solvents and cyclic ethers such as THF and 2-methyltetrahydrofuran (mTHF) as WS solvents. Four electrolyte solutions, namely, 1.0 M NaPF $_{6}$ DME/THF (NMT), 1.0 M NaPF $_{6}$ DME/mTHF (NMM), 1.0 M NaPF $_{6}$ Triglyme/mTHF (NTrT), and 1.0 M NaPF $_{6}$ DIG/mTHF (NDM)

association_citations.quote: We argue that tuning the solvation structure through introducing solvents with various solvation capability could enhance the solubility of salt by decreasing the system degree of order ( $\Delta S > 0$ ) at low temperature. More specifically, mixing an SS solvent and a WS solvent could have more diverse solvation structure that is capable of altering spontaneously in response to the temperature dropping, and thus, realizing a temperature-adaptive electrolyte (Figure 1b). As a proof of concept, we selected $NaPF_{6}$ as a representative salt to pair with an SS–WS ether solvent mixture. To minimize any potential impact of $\varepsilon$ and DN on the solvation structure, DIG and tetrahydrofuran (THF) solvents with similar $\varepsilon$ (7.23 vs 7.58) and DN (19.5 vs 20.0 kcal mol $^{-1}$ ) values, $^{[15,16]}$ were specifically chosen as the SS and WS solvents, respectively (Table S1, Supporting Information). We first optimized our proposed SS–WS electrolyte formulation to 1.0 M $NaPF_{6}$ dissolved in DIG and THF (2:8 in volume ratio, denoted as NDT, Figure S5, Supporting Information). To compare, 1.0 M $NaPF_{6}$ dissolved in THF (denoted as NT) was chosen as the WS electrolyte and 1.0 M $NaPF_{6}$ dissolved in DIG (denoted as ND) as the SS electrolyte. We then used density functional theory (DFT) calculations to determine the binding energies $(E_{\mathrm{b}})$ of cation–solvent complexes based on the optimized geometrical structures (Figure S1, Supporting Information).

At a current density of $100\mathrm{mA}\mathrm{g}^{-1}$ , the capacity retentions at $25$ °C after 500 and 1000 cycles are $89.1\%$ and $86.2\%$ , respectively (see Figure S10, Supporting Information), and the capacity retention at $-40$ °C after 500 cycles is $95.4\%$ . The initial discharge capacity for NDT at $25$ °C and $-40$ °C are 300.1 and $254.8\mathrm{mAhg}^{-1}$ , respectively. d,e) Arrhenius behaviour of the resistance corresponding to $\mathrm{Na^{+}}$ transport through SEI (d) and charge-transfer processes (e). The unique SS–WS solvation structure also tunes the SEI composition toward more ion conductive nature responding to the change of temperature, yet another evidence for the temperature-adaptive feature of our NDT electrolyte.

citations.quote: For example, $NaClO_{4}$ is very explosive and its adsorbed $H_{2}O$ is too difficult to dry out. $^{[28]}$ $NaPF_{6}$ is toxic and expensive, easy to decompose at elevated temperatures and under humidity. $^{[5,14]}$ The NaTFSI and NaFSI are of high cost, and the $TFSI^{-}$ (or $FSI^{-}$ ) anion in NaTFSI (or NaFSI) has a corrosive effect on the aluminum foil collector. $^{[8]}$ Thus, it is of great significance to explore advanced salts to promote the wide applicability of SIBs. Sodium difluoro(oxalato)borate (NaDFOB), which has non-localized electrons in the structure and weak bonds between sodium-ions and anions, has shown fascinating properties, such as high conductivity, compatibility with a variety of solvents, and own film-forming characteristics with no need for film-forming additives. $^{[14,29,30]}$ However, the use of NaDFOB as a single salt for electrolytes and their compatibility with different SIB electrodes have rarely been reported.

citations.chunk_id: 0070_Xia 等 - 2025 - Sodium-DifluorooxalatoBorate-Based Electrolytes for Long-Term Cycle Life and Enhanced Low-Temperat::sec1::child3
citations.quote: We have thoroughly examined its application as a single salt for the electrolytes of SIBs. The NaDFOB facilitates the formation of a dense and robust cathode-electrolyte interface (CEI) layer on the $\mathrm{Na_{3}Fe_{2}(PO_{4})P_{2}O_{7}}$ (NFPP) cathode, significantly enhances its cyclability and Coulombic efficiency (CE). Specifically, the NFPP electrode demonstrates an impressive capacity retention of 98.7% after 1000 cycles along with an average CE of 99.96%. Moreover, the hard carbon (HC)//NFPP pouch cell with NaDFOB-diethylene glycol dimethyl ether (G2) electrolyte shows an extended cycling lifespan of 500 cycles and commendable low-temperature performance. Our findings contribute to the exploration of affordable and functional sodium salts, thereby advancing the practical implementation of SIBs in various applications.

The electrolytes with different concentrations of NaDFOB in G2 were prepared, which allows for concentrations greater than 2 M (Figure S1, Supporting Information). To make a better contrast with conventional electrolytes, the 1 M NaDFOB-G2 electrolyte was chosen for subsequent characterization. The oxidation potential of the NaDFOB-G2 electrolyte was measured by the linear sweep voltammetry (LSV).

citations.quote:
To show the potential for low-temperature application, the NFPP electrodes with different electrolytes were tested at low temperatures. Notably, the NFPP electrode with NaDFOB-G2 electrolyte exhibits a capacity retention of 92.7% at -20 °C compared to that at 25 °C. Even at -40 °C, a high capacity retention of 84.8% is achieved (Figure 2g,h). Impressively, the NFPP electrode with the NaDFOB-G2 electrolyte retains higher capacity retention than that with $NaPF_{6}-G2$ electrolyte at both -20 and -40 °C (Figures S6 and S7, Supporting Information). Moreover, the NaDFOB-G2 electrolyte works well with other cathode materials. Both the $\mathrm{Na_{3}V_{2}(PO_{4})_{3}}$ and $\mathrm{Na_{3}V_{2}(PO_{4})_{2}F_{3}}$ electrodes show high cycling stability over 200 cycles (Figures S8 and S9, Supporting Information). Additionally, the compatibility of the NaDFOB-G2 electrolyte with the hard carbon (HC) anode is also evaluated. The HC electrode has a large overpotential at room temperature and shows a small capacity (Figure S10, Supporting Information), which may be result of the thick SEI film on the Na metal surface slowing down the speed of sodium-ions passing through the SEI film and increase the polarization of the cell (Figure S11, Supporting Information). $^{[8]}$

To avoid the influence of the high polarization from Na metal, HC//NFPP full coin-cells were assembled.

association_citations.quote: We have thoroughly examined its application as a single salt for the electrolytes of SIBs. citations.quote: Kang's group $^{[48]}$ evaluated the electrochemical behavior of graphite electrodes using various glymes, i.e., TEGDME, DEGDME, and DME, as solvents and NaPF $_6$ , NaClO $_4$ , and NaCF $_3$ SO $_3$ salts. The results clearly highlighted that, while the salt has negligible influence, the solvent plays a key role on both intercalation potential and rate capability. An increase of the glyme molecular weight was found to increase the intercalation potential but decreasing the rate capability. The NaPF $_6$ in DEGDME electrolyte was selected for the realization of a full cell in combination with Na $_{1.5}$ VPO $_{4.8}$ F $_{0.7}$ cathode, characterized by a working voltage of 3 V, capacity of 45 mAh g $^{-1}$ (with respect to the mass of both the electrodes), good rate capability and promising capacity retention (80% after 250 cycles). $^{[48]}$ The correlation between the glyme molecular weight with the intercalation potential and the rate capability was later confirmed by Jache and co-workers. $^{[49]}$ Kang's group $^{[50]}$ investigated the solvated Na $^+$ intercalation mechanism using operando X-ray diffraction analysis, electrochemical titration, real-time optical observation, and density functional theory (DFT) calculations.

citations.chunk_id: 0002_Cai 等 - 2024 - A dual-functional electrolyte additive for stabilizing the solid electrolyte interphase and solvatio::sec3::child1
citations.quote:
As is well known, sodium salts, a medium for ion conductivity and sodium sources for sothiation/de-sothiation process, plays an essential role in determining the electrochemical performance of SIBs. Therefore,

Ming [3] et al. evaluated the properties of sodium hexafluorophosphate (NaPF $_6$ ), sodium perchlorate (NaClO $_4$ ), sodium trifluoromethanesulfonate (NaOTF) and sodium tetrafluoroborate (NaBF $_4$ ) as main salts. Among them, NaPF $_6$ was proven to have the best comprehensive performance including high solubility, high thermal stability and optimized orbital energy level. The compatibility of sodium salts and solvents/additives is considerably important for the function of the sodium salts. Generally, the solvents with additives are mainly used as a medium to transport sodium ions, affecting the conductivity and viscosity of the electrolyte, solvating the electrolyte salts, and ensuring the transmission of sodium ions. Yi et al. [4] incorporated a HC anode protected by ester-originated SEI with ether-based electrolyte, which indeed fused the merits of ester- and ether-based electrolytes and achieved a high reversibility and rate capability. Che et al. [5] systematically studied the carbonate-based electrolytes for NFM/HC SIBs and demonstrated that as compared with ethylene carbonate (EC)-based electrolyte, Propylene carbonate (PC)-based electrolytes outperform better in terms of capacity retention and safety.

requirements.requirement: Salt concentration 0.8 mol/L NaPF6
requirements.reasoning: The source's ECC formulation is explicitly given as 0.8 M NaPF6 in EC/PC/EMC, matching the candidate's 0.8 M NaPF6 concentration.

citations.quote: As a recent upstart in the field of energy storage, the energy storage efficiency of SIBs under high temperature conditions is one of the main research focuses. Capacity retention of the SIBs with/without NaDFP after 7 days, 14 days, and 28 days of shelving under 60 °C are shown in the Fig. 4c. Capacity retention of the batteries with NaDFP remains 83 % after 14 days. Even after 28 days, it still remains a capacity of 69 %. These results show that the cells with NaDFP exhibit less energy loss after each pause as compared to the baseline, apparently meaning less anodic decomposition of the electrolyte, less CEI dissolution/repair, and/or less ions dissolution. In addition to high temperature, battery stability at high voltages is also affected by EC oxidation. As shown in the Fig. 4d, the capacity retention of battery with NaDFP slightly improved under 60 °C, 4 V after 150 cycles. In previous work, it was found that PC has better cycling stability at the cathode electrodes. Therefore, in order to obtain better cycle performance, EC was partially replaced by PC while NaDFP being introduced as shown in Fig. 4e (ECC-0.8 M NaPF $_{6}$ EC/PC/EMC = 0.5:2:0.5). Moreover, in order to understand the dissolution behavior of transition metals in the NFM cathodes with and without NaDFP, the amount of transition metals deposited on the hard carbon anodes after 100 cycles at 45 °C was measured by ICP-OES [19]. Lower contents of Ni and Fe were detected on the anode with NaDFP.

在形成候选前，逐项检查用户目标是否已有相关证据。近似温度是选材目标，仍需

### 逆向设计例外：先诊断，筛选仅决定能否推荐配方

   不得把整段用户问题放入 `target_conditions`，再把旧文本检查识别到的部分词语当成全部要求。

   （如 “discharged at 1 C”、“cycled at 0.5 C”、“1 C rate”），才是倍率。
   按上下文确定一种解释后，就用这一种建立约束，
   不因缺少度符号再补一条互斥的倍率或温度约束，也不因检索结果改回另一种解释。
   检索查询和筛选断言须明确写出所采用的
   物理量与单位。只有上下文确实无法确定物理量时，才同时列出两种解释并说明需要澄清，

   接近目标温度的文献结果应保留实测温度，不能改写为目标温度。
   硬约束来自用户问题，不得自行加上某一正极、软包形式、长循环寿命或数值阈值。
   在若干可替代选项之间尚未确定时（例如某类溶剂或某类盐有多种候选），不得把它们

   近似目标也必须进入筛选，不得因用户没有给出容差而省略。保留用户对目标的原话，

   无法从问题得出数值判据的定性目标，保留为选材目标，在报告中说明依据和待验证
   条件。定性或近似目标通过断言及其原文依据判断，不变成必须命中字面词的关键词条件。
   这不允许省略用户明确给出的电极、电池形式、精确温度或倍率要求。
   当用户目标包含某项性能指标（如 capacity retention relative to room-temperature
   capacity、离子电导率、倍率性能、首圈库仑效率），先分清用户给的是**数值阈值**还是
   **只要报告**：给了明确数值时写成对应数值约束——保持率用 `minimum_retention`、
   电导率用 `minimum_conductivity`、倍率用 `c_rate`，`value` 取用户给出的数值；
   只要求“报告该指标”“有无该结果”而未给数值时，不得把阈值填 0 了事——`value: 0`
   会让任何数字都通过，等于没有检查。这类“须被报告/须成立”的指标改用
   `kind: "evidence_claim"`（见下），把该指标写成一句断言。
   `field_presence` 只用于检查候选的配方字段（`concentration_mol_l`、
   `solvent_ratios`、`additives` 等）是否显式填写，绝不用于表达“某项性能必须被报告”。
   禁止把“capacity retention … must be reported”写成
   `"kind": "field_presence", "field": "additives"` 这类把性能指标错配到配方字段的约束。
   ```json
   {
     "request": {
       "candidates": candidates,
       "constraint_records": [
         {
           "constraint_id": "temp-low",
           "description": "operating temperature ≤ -20°C",
           "kind": "temperature",
           "operator": "<=",
           "value": -20,
           "unit": "°C",
           "required_evidence_scope": "candidate_same_paper",
           "can_replan": true,
           "search_hint": "find low-temperature cycling evidence"
         },
         {
           "constraint_id": "electrode-hard-carbon",
           "description": "hard carbon anode",
           "kind": "electrode_material",
           "evidence_terms": ["hard carbon", "hard-carbon"],
           "required_evidence_scope": "candidate_same_paper",
           "can_replan": true,
           "search_hint": "find hard carbon anode evidence"
         },
         {
           "constraint_id": "cell-half",
           "description": "sodium half-cell configuration",
           "kind": "cell_configuration",
           "evidence_terms": ["half-cell", "half cell", "Na||HC", "HC||Na", "pure Na"],
           "required_evidence_scope": "candidate_same_paper",
           "can_replan": true,
           "search_hint": "find half-cell configuration evidence"
         },
         {
           "constraint_id": "field-concentration",
           "description": "explicit salt concentration must be present",
           "kind": "field_presence",
           "field": "concentration_mol_l",
           "required_evidence_scope": "candidate_same_paper",
           "can_replan": false
         },
         {
           "constraint_id": "salt-napf6",
           "description": "NaPF6 as salt",
           "kind": "required_component",
           "value": "NaPF6",
           "required_evidence_scope": "candidate_same_paper",
           "can_replan": true,
           "search_hint": "find NaPF6 electrolyte evidence"
         },
         {
           "constraint_id": "solvent-thf",
           "description": "THF as solvent",
           "kind": "required_component",
           "value": "THF",
           "required_evidence_scope": "candidate_same_paper",
           "can_replan": true,
           "search_hint": "find THF solvent evidence"
         }
       ]
     }
   }
   ```
   定性或断言型要求（如“无集流体/壳体腐蚀被观测到”“无析钠/无枝晶”“提高首圈库仑效率”
   “该添加剂抑制产气”）不得写成 `mechanism_keyword` 关键词表——关键词命中分不清
   “发生腐蚀”与“未发生腐蚀”。改用 `kind: "evidence_claim"`：在 `claim` 里用一句
   用户原话写出对单个候选须成立的断言，在 `claim_verdicts` 里**逐候选**给出判定。
   语义判断（这段原文是否为该候选建立或推翻该断言）由你负责；程序只做两件可机械
   核验的事：判定须指向本次请求的候选，`quote` 须在该候选证据正文中逐字存在。
   因此措辞、否定、同义称呼的变化都不影响判定，你只需如实读原文：
   - `supported`：有原文明确为该候选建立断言，附 `chunk_id` 与逐字 `quote`；
   - `refuted`：有原文明确反驳（如原文说“会持续腐蚀铝箔”），附 `chunk_id` 与逐字 `quote`；
   - `not_found`：检索到的证据未直接提及，如实填写，由补证机制驱动下一轮检索。
   背景介绍、他人体系的结果、无实验支撑的预测都不算 `supported`。例如：
   ```json
   {
     "constraint_id": "no-corrosion",
     "description": "no current-collector or case corrosion observed",
     "kind": "evidence_claim",
     "claim": "该候选电解液不腐蚀铝箔或钢壳",
     "claim_verdicts": [
       {
         "candidate_id": "candidate-1",
         "verdict": "refuted",
         "chunk_id": "fan2024::sec3",
         "quote": "the single NaFSI system can continuously corrode aluminum foil and stainless steel sheets",
         "basis": "原文明确说明单盐 NaFSI 会持续腐蚀铝箔与不锈钢，与该断言相反。"
       }
     ],
     "can_replan": true,
     "search_hint": "find corrosion test evidence for the candidate electrolyte"
   }
   ```
   `evidence_claim` 不得把 `required_evidence_scope` 设为 `component` 或 `background`：
   断言必须由候选自身绑定的证据支持，不能借用别篇论文或背景段落的措辞。
   给出 `supported` 前，逐句核对引文是否真正支持所写断言。引文必须从指定
   `chunk_id` 返回的原文复制，不能把题名、摘要或另一块文字放在该块的标识下。
   配方、测试条件和性能必须对应同一候选；一种优点不能替代另一项目标的证据。
   成本动机与价格比较分别表述，安全性或无氟组成不能自行推导出成本优势。
   `basis` 说明原句与断言的推理关系，不得以重复断言代替理由。程序核验引文
   存在及归属，不代替科学含义判断；证据未支持完整断言时应补证或保留 `not_found`。
   `criteria`/`target_conditions` 仅用于兼容旧调用方；新设计任务必须优先使用
   `constraint_records`，避免 evaluator 再从自由文本猜测硬约束。

   `required_evidence_kinds` 描述的是**支持记录本身的语义角色**，不是实验条件元数据。
   数值性能约束通常只要求 `property`；温度、电极、循环数等共同实例化条件应由该
   observation 的 `condition_scope` 和 `joint_context_requirements` 表达。除非硬约束本身
   确实要求一条独立的 condition 记录，否则不要把同一数值约束写成
   `required_evidence_kinds=["property", "condition"]`，否则会把“带条件上下文的性能观测”
   错当成缺少第二种证据角色。

   当两个及以上硬约束必须在**同一个目标实验上下文**中同时成立时，还必须显式写
   `joint_context_requirements`。分别在多个倍率测试的要求，按倍率分别建立条件组，
   每组的 `target_context.rate` 只填一个倍率。不能把 `0.5 C and 1 C` 当成一次测试的倍率。
   同一论文的不同盐浓度或溶剂比例必须分别对应其性能段，不能因来自同篇论文就互换结果。
   `target_context.cell_configuration` 使用条件检查器的外形名称 `pouch` 或 `coin`，
   不拼成 `pouch full cell` 这样的新标签。全电池要求另用 cell_configuration 检查条件
   和明确的正负极对验证；外形名称不能代替电极与全电池要求。
   它描述的是 evidence composition obligation，不要求所有
   支持证据拥有相同 `experiment_id`。`constraint_ids` 只能引用本次 `constraint_records`；
   `context_fields` 只列对联合决策真正相关的字段；`target_context` 只填写用户明确给出的
   目标条件，未知字段保持未知，禁止为了让 join 成立而补默认值。例如：
   ```json
   {
     "joint_context_requirements": [
       {
         "group_id": "low-temp-high-voltage",
         "constraint_ids": ["retention", "voltage"],
         "context_fields": ["temperature_c", "electrode"],
         "target_context": {"temperature_c": -20.0, "electrode": "hard carbon"},
         "can_replan": true,
         "search_hint": "find evidence satisfying both hard constraints at the target operating context"
       }
     ]
   }
   ```
   只有约束确实需要共同实例化时才声明 joint group；互不相关的硬约束不要强行合组。
   原文条件检查器分别识别 `electrode` 与 `cell_configuration`。涉及电池形式的用户要求
   使用独立的 cell_configuration 条件；只有相关观测明确提供该字段时，才作联合检查。
2. 检查用户输入与已有 ledger；存在组分、机理或替代体系缺口时，选择相应检索能力；
3. 如证据不足，再做有界补充检索：
   - 区分“已有候选缺少一段证据”和“已有候选并不适合目标”。先检查最相关论文；
     若当前候选仍不能满足目标，按缺口与完整目标检索其他候选，不反复只查原来的
     盐、溶剂或论文。新证据支持新的组成时重新组装候选，再用原任务的全部条件
     筛选。不能把不同候选的成本、工况或性能拼成一个通过的候选。
   - 尚未定位候选论文时，用 `search_literature_chunks` 做 1–2 次聚焦补充（`top_k=10`）；
   - 若返回结果已经给出明确 `paper_id`，且该论文与目标组分/机理直接相关但缺少显式配方或目标工况证据，必须对最相关的 1 篇论文调用一次 `search_paper_chunks(paper_id=..., query=..., top_k=8)`；`query` 用 4–8 个英文技术词描述缺失事实，不含作者名。将结果追加到 `evidence_chunks`，不得跨论文拼接配方与性能。
   - 对 **named-study / named-candidate** 设计任务，在进入 `query_formulation_space` 或
     `screen_formulations` 前，必须先取得同一论文中可追溯的配方/组成证据：至少有一条
     `evidence_kind="formulation"` 的记录能支持候选的盐、溶剂或添加剂组成。只有性能、温度、
     机理 chunk 不能建立候选配方归属；若当前只找到性能证据，应继续检索 formulation /
     composition 段落，而不是手工构造一个 `formulation_evidence_ids=[]` 的候选进入筛选。
4. 用户没有提供可评估候选时，调用 `query_formulation_space`，把目标转成：
   `{"request":{"task_type":"design","target_conditions":[...],"preferred_salts":[...],"preferred_solvents":[...],"preferred_additives":[...],"excluded_components":[...],"evidence_chunks": evidence_chunks,"max_candidates":3}}`；其中 `evidence_chunks` 必须传入前面检索实际返回、与目标最相关的最多 12 个 chunk，不得只传组分偏好而丢失文献上下文。工具会优先从这些同论文原文块组装候选，再使用 KG fallback；保留工具原样返回的 `candidates`。
   如果候选 evidence 只有 `chunk_id` 而 `text/excerpt` 为空，先调用
   `enrich_formulation_evidence({"request":{"candidates": candidates}})`，并用返回候选
   替换原列表；证据已有原文时不得为形式完整重复调用。enrichment 只补齐原文和元数据，
   必须保留原 evidence 的 `paper_id`、`evidence_kind` 和 `chunk_id`。
5. 若任务涉及离子电导率、温度下的传输性质或需要在多个 NaPF6–EC/EMC/PC 候选之间增加一个轻量定量参考，可在筛选前调用 `predict_formulation_conductivity`。只有以下两种情况允许数值预测：候选已有明确的 NaPF6/EC/EMC/PC 摩尔组成，或调用参数中的 `composition_inputs[candidate_id]` 显式给出 `component_mmol`、`molar_ratios` 或 `x_NaSalt/x_EC/x_PC`。现有 `solvent_ratios` 没有保存 v/v、w/w 或 molar 基准，因此**不得**仅凭“1 M + 1:1”之类字段推导模型输入。含其他盐、其他溶剂或添加剂的候选按域外处理；组成不足时保留 `insufficient_composition`，继续依赖文献/KG 证据。`model_predictions` 与 literature evidence 必须分开：模型预测可以辅助候选比较和后续实验优先级，但不能单独把实验事实型硬约束判为满足。
6. 只有需要形成配方推荐或明确 hold 时才调用 `screen_formulations`：
   传入当前候选和完整的结构化 `constraint_records`。旧文本字段用于兼容历史输入，
   新设计任务不能用它们替代结构化条件。
   每项 `claim_verdicts` 只判定本次 `candidates` 中实际提交的候选。候选集合变更时，
   同步更新各断言的候选判定，保持原任务的全部条件。工具返回参数错误后，修复
   指出的字段并重新提交完整请求，不得删去 `constraint_records` 或联合条件来消除报错。
    倍率与循环次数是两种不同测试，分别建立约束：指定 1 C 测试使用
    `{"kind":"c_rate","operator":"==","value":1,"unit":"C"}`；
    100 次循环使用 `{"kind":"minimum_cycles","value":100,"unit":"cycles"}`。
    指定 2.0–4.0 V 测试使用
    `{"kind":"voltage_window","operator":"==","value":[2.0,4.0],"unit":"V"}`。
    若任务要求 0.5 C 和 1 C，各自建立条件。
    双盐配方同时保存 `salts` 与 `salt_concentrations_mol_l`，分别记录各盐浓度；
    `concentration_mol_l` 表示总盐浓度，不得将它归给某一个盐。
    `solvent_ratio_basis` 按原文填写 `mass`、`volume` 或 `molar`；原文未说明时填
    `unknown`。不得把质量比例当成体积比例，或把溶剂比例直接当成包括盐的摩尔组成。
   若本任务已声明 `joint_context_requirements`，每次首次筛选和补证后的重新筛选都必须携带
   同一份 joint-context 合同；除非用户明确修改任务目标，否则不得在 re-screen 时删除、
   放宽 `context_fields` 或改写 `target_context`。runtime 会在字段被意外省略时保留上一版
   显式合同，但 Agent 仍应主动原样传递。
   保留工具原样返回的 `screening_results`、其中的 `criteria_evaluations` 与 `gaps`，
   不得手写分数、validations 或 scores。任何 `failed`、`insufficient_evidence` 或
   `unsupported` 判定都不得在报告中表述为性能已验证。
7. 旧调用方需要动作列表时，可调用 `optimize_formulations`：
   `{"candidates": candidates,"screening_results": screening_results,"request":{"task_type":"design","objectives":[目标性能...],"constraints":[用户硬约束...]}}`。
   不得同时传入 `validations` 或 `scores`。该兼容工具只翻译筛选后已经产生的
   `DecisionState`，不会再按 score 独立裁决；若 proposal 为
   `retrieve_more_evidence`，先执行对应的补充检索和重新筛选，再进入报告。
8. `DecisionState` 已达到 `recommend` 或 `hold` 后，必须**立即**调用 `synthesize_design_report`
   生成完整报告，并传入同一份原始 `screening_results`：
   `{"request":{"task_type":"design","question":用户问题,"evidence_chunks": evidence_chunks,"candidates": candidates,"screening_results": screening_results}}`。
   为提升 `claim_supported_ratio`，请在 `request.claims` 中提交**所有**被 `evidence_chunks` 直接支持的事实声明（`claim_type="fact"`），每条包含 `text`、对应 `chunk_id` 和唯一逐字原文引文 `evidence_quote`（必须从该 chunk 的 `content` 中逐字截取，且只出现一次）。**禁止为凑数量编造 claim**；若当前证据能直接支持的 claim 不足 2 条，应优先通过 `search_literature_chunks` 或 `search_paper_chunks` 补充检索，最多尝试 2 轮；若仍无法找到更多直接支持，则在报告中明确标注“证据不足”，并只提交已被验证的 claim。报告将渲染“已校验事实”小节，避免裁判从自由文本中抽取不被检索上下文支持的论断。
   报告要让使用者能安排下一步工作。用简明中文分别提交配方组成、文献的测试条件与数值、同条件基准配方的结果，并保留逐字引文。比例需说明质量比或体积比；浓度、添加剂用量不得省略或猜测。文献筛选不能写成新配方已由本智能体实验验证。
   当目标是某项性能时，报告必须包含已检索到的该项性能结果，不能只列出温度、
   电极和电压范围等测试设置。不同盐浓度、溶剂比例和添加剂分支的结果分别绑定到
   其配方。不得借用另一分支较好的结果；保留同一分支完整组成与性能已明确的候选，
   不必强求选取数值最高但组成仍缺失的分支。
   `next_steps` 按本次缺口列出具体核查或实验，包括要比较的配方、温度、倍率、电池类型和测量项目；这些是验证计划，不是已取得的结果。即使为 `hold`，也要展示已取得的候选资料、文献结果和暂缓原因，不得只写状态或检索流程。
   对没有数值判据的选材目标，`next_steps` 也要交代其验证状态。例如成本目标
   需要区分文献的成本动机与实际价格比较，不能因筛选通过就宣称全部目标已验证。
   性能类 `claims` 应优先包含与当前候选直接相连的实验结果，少选一般背景介绍。
   **关键纪律**：一旦 `screen_formulations` 返回 `hold` 或 `recommend`，**不得**再尝试重新构建候选、重新检索或输出自由文本；下一动作必须是 `synthesize_design_report`。若状态为 `search`，最多只做一轮补充检索 + 重新筛选，然后必须进入报告。
9. 直接输出报告全文，不得改写或截断。

## 退出纪律

- 不要求无条件调用所有工具；根据用户已有候选和结构化 evidence gaps 选择能力。
- `synthesize_design_report` 是终端编译能力。调用前必须已有终态 `DecisionState`；
  `search` 状态必须先按缺口补证或换候选，不能用固定工具次数代替状态判断。
- `recommend` 只推荐 approved candidates；`hold` 展示已检索的候选资料与文献结果，说明缺口和验证计划，不推荐或排序候选。

## 候选方案纪律

- 候选配方必须来自 KG 结构化证据或文献 chunk；
- 对于"建议组合"（无完整配方直接实验数据），summary 只写组分和证据来源，不写性能声明；
- 性能/效果声明只能绑定到直接支持该声明的 chunk_id；
- 禁止在"证据摘要"里写入未被任何 chunk 直接支持的推断句；无来源支撑的直接删除；
- **直接回答（direct_answer）只给出候选方案标识和最精简组成**，不要包含"已在某温度验证"、"性能最优"、"最有效"等需要跨证据推断的断言；
- 推荐完整配方必须有原文明确的钠盐浓度。若浓度未知，列为待补资料，不得填入
  “参考基准配方”的浓度并作为已有文献验证的配方推荐。

## 推荐/排序纪律

- 排序理由必须逐条绑定到具体 chunk_id，禁止写"C1/C3/C4 无法满足需求"、"某候选明显优于其他"等无直接对比证据的绝对化断言；
- 无直接对比证据时，只陈述各候选的组分、证据来源与评分，不给出相对优劣结论；
- 对"建议组合"的推荐，只能说明其组分和所依据的证据，不得把多篇证据的性能迁移到该组合上。

## 证据摘要纪律

- 配方段落若讨论多种浓度、多个溶剂比例或不同研究，先定位到单一配方的原文。
  不得把某段的浓度、另一配方的溶剂比例和第三个体系的添加剂拼成候选。
  原文工具返回中的数值、温度符号、配方标识和 chunk_id 应原样沿用，
  不得手工改写成另一温度或用整篇论文的共同身份代替相同测试条件。
- 每条 bullet 必须附带 `[chunk_id]`；
- 禁止输出以"【推断】"开头的句子；
- 禁止把多篇证据的性能迁移到某个候选配方上。

## 引用纪律

- 使用 `[chunk_id]` 格式；
- 禁止引用模型参数知识里的文献；
- 单篇报道就写"某文献报道/某体系显示"，不得升格为普适结论。

## KG 质量反馈

检索或分析过程中，若发现以下可疑情况，**必须**调用 `flag_suspicious_kg_item` 记录，供后续离线人工审查与 KG 矫正；不阻塞当前设计流程。

- **实体标签错误**：如 `ionic conductivity` 被标为 `Additive`，`NaPF6` 被标为 `Solvent`；
- **关系方向/语义错误**：如 `SEI DECOMPOSITION::FORMS::FEC`、明显违背化学常识的关系；
- **属性单位或数值异常**：如电导率 `100 mS/cm` 与上下文矛盾、温度单位混用；
- **同名异义**：如 `TMP` 同时指 `trimethyl phosphate` 与 `2,4,6-trimethylpyridine` 而未区分；
- **证据与 KG 矛盾**：chunk 中的明确结论与 KG 检索结果冲突。

记录时尽量提供：item_type（`entity`/`relation`/`property`）、具体名称/ID、问题描述、触发工具、证据 chunk_id。

## 知识沉淀

设计流程全部结束后，调用 `reflect_now` 进行知识反思和 Wiki 沉淀，
将本次设计的关键结论、发现的知识缺口、改进的检索关键词记录到 LLM Wiki，
供下次相似问题时直接检索复用，减少重复检索成本。

Being abundant in nature, biomass is the most attractive precursors for producing hard carbon (HC) anodes for Na-ion batteries. A reversible capacity of 309 mAh g $^{-1}$ is delivered, with an initial Coulombic efficiency of 80%. Introduction
Sodium-ion batteries (SIBs) have been an attractive alternative for the post lithium-ion battery due to the wide abundance and low cost of sodium resources. $^{[1-7]}$ The electrolyte is known as the “blood” of SIBs and interacts closely with the cathode and anode. $^{[8-13]}$ The electrolyte not only plays an important role in regulating the properties of the electrode/electrolyte interface but also has a crucial impact on the battery performance, including reversible capacity, rate capability, cycling stability, high and low-temperature performance, and safety. $^{[14-20]}$ Therefore, it is very important to explore advanced electrolytes to achieve high-performance SIBs.

The sodium salt is the main component of electrolytes of SIBs, which directly determines the electrochemical characteristics of electrolytes. $^{[21-23]}$ At present, the commonly used sodium salts are mainly sodium hexafluorophosphate (NaPF $_{6}$ ), sodium perchlorate (NaClO $_{4}$ ), sodium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide (NaTFSI), and sodium

bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide (NaFSI). $^{[24-27]}$ However, all these salts have shortcomings for large-scale application. For example, $NaClO_{4}$ is very explosive and its adsorbed $H_{2}O$ is too difficult to dry out. $^{[28]}$ $NaPF_{6}$ is toxic and expensive, easy to decompose at elevated temperatures and under humidity. $^{[5,14]}$ The NaTFSI and NaFSI are of high cost, and the $TFSI^{-}$ (or $FSI^{-}$ ) anion in NaTFSI (or NaFSI) has a corrosive effect on the aluminum foil collector. $^{[8]}$ Thus, it is of great significance to explore advanced salts to promote the wide applicability of SIBs. Sodium difluoro(oxalato)borate (NaDFOB), which has non-localized electrons in the structure and weak bonds between sodium-ions and anions, has shown fascinating properties, such as high conductivity, compatibility with a variety of solvents, and own film-forming characteristics with no need for film-forming additives. $^{[14,29,30]}$ However, the use of NaDFOB as a single salt for electrolytes and their compatibility with different SIB electrodes have rarely been reported. One reason may be the concern of its high cost as the current synthesis process for NaDFOB is complex, dangerous, and costly. $^{[29]}$

evidence.text: The electrolytes with different concentrations of NaDFOB in G2 were prepared, which allows for concentrations greater than 2 M. ... Impressively, the conductivity of the electrolyte reaches up to 6.8 mS cm $^{-1}$ at 1 M and achieves the highest value of 7.94 mS cm $^{-1}$ at 1.4 M. To make a better contrast with conventional electrolytes, the 1 M NaDFOB-G2 electrolyte was chosen for subsequent characterization.

evidence.text: To show the potential for low-temperature application, the NFPP electrodes with different electrolytes were tested at low temperatures. Notably, the NFPP electrode with NaDFOB-G2 electrolyte exhibits a capacity retention of 92.7% at -20 °C compared to that at 25 °C. Even at -40 °C, a high capacity retention of 84.8% is achieved (Figure 2g,h). ... Moreover, the NaDFOB-G2 electrolyte works well with other cathode materials. Both the $\mathrm{Na_{3}V_{2}(PO_{4})_{3}}$ and $\mathrm{Na_{3}V_{2}(PO_{4})_{2}F_{3}}$ electrodes show high cycling stability over 200 cycles (Figures S8 and S9, Supporting Information).

evidence.text: Furthermore, an Ah-level hard carbon (HC)//NFPP pouch cell using NaDFOB-based ether electrolyte shows an impressive cycle life of 500 cycles, coupled with an average Coulombic efficiency of 99.9%. The pouch cells also maintain superior electrochemical performance across a broad temperature range from -40 to 60 °C, showcasing the electrolyte's versatility.

evidence.text: Coin cells (CR2032) were used to test the electrochemical performances. 1M NaClO $_{4}$ solution in a mixture of ethylene carbonate/propylene carbonate (EC/PC) (1:1 in volume) was applied as the electrolyte for the half cell and full cells. Two pieces of Whatman glass fibers soaked with the electrolyte were used as the separator between the positive and negative electrode. The HC electrode was prepared by casting a slurry of 90 wt% HC, 5 wt% conductive carbon black and 5 wt% polyvinylidene fluoride (PVDF) binder on copper foil. Typical loading mass of the HC electrode was around 1.5 mg cm $^{-2}$ . For the full cell, Na $_{3.5}$ V $_{2}$ (PO $_{4}$ ) $_{2}$ F $_{3}$ powders were mixed with 20% carbon SP for the preparation of positive electrodes. The weight ratio of the positive/negative electrodes was 2.5.

evidence_chunks.chunk_id: 0036_Lin 等 - 2019 - Exploring room- and low-temperature performance of hard carbon material in half and full Na-ion batt::sec5::child0
evidence_chunks.content: Coin cells (CR2032) were used to test the electrochemical performances. 1M NaClO $_{4}$ solution in a mixture of ethylene carbonate/propylene carbonate (EC/PC) (1:1 in volume) was applied as the electrolyte for the half cell and full cells. Two pieces of Whatman glass fibers soaked with the electrolyte were used as the separator between the positive and negative electrode. The HC electrode was prepared by casting a slurry of 90 wt% HC, 5 wt% conductive carbon black and 5 wt% polyvinylidene fluoride (PVDF) binder on copper foil. In companions, electrodes using carboxymethylcellulose sodium salt (CMC) and sodium alginate (NaAg) as the binder were also prepared. Typical loading mass of the HC electrode was around 1.5 mg cm $^{-2}$ . For the full cell, Na $_{3.5}$ V $_{2}$ (PO $_{4}$ ) $_{2}$ F $_{3}$ powders were mixed with 20% carbon SP for the preparation of positive electrodes. The weight ratio of the positive/negative electrodes was 2.5. The cells were galvanostatic charged/discharged with a LAND 2001 CT battery test system (Wuhan, China) under various voltage ranges and current rates. Electrochemical impedance spectroscopy (EIS) was carried out on a VMP system (Biologic S.A., Claix, France).

evidence_chunks.chunk_id: 0036_Lin 等 - 2019 - Exploring room- and low-temperature performance of hard carbon material in half and full Na-ion batt::sec2::child2
evidence_chunks.content: In view of this, there are few studies for low temperature NIBs using hard carbon as the anode. Instead, more attention is attracted to the alloy or carbon/alloy composite for their adequate capacity of around 100 mAh g $^{-1}$ at low temperatures, such as Ti-based metal oxides, $^{[16,17]}$ , Se/graphene $^{[18]}$ and Sb/CNT $^{[19]}$ composites. However, these anode materials are accompanied by the high average voltage, which is detrimental to the energy density of the full cell. Previous work indicates that the capacity of hard carbon may be fully utilized by lowering the cut-off potential to below 0 V. $^{[20]}$ It indeed allows a high capacity of 265 mAh g $^{-1}$ at -15 °C, $^{[21]}$ although the possibility of Na plating requires prudent investigation. In this work, the calcination protocol of synthesizing HC from biomass waste is systematically explored. It shows a significant dependence of the performance on the heat treatment processes. The optimized HC was then evaluated at both the room and low-temperature. Assisted with the in situ and ex situ XRD, the possibility of Na metal plating is thoroughly examined. A safe and reversible capacity of 250 mAh g $^{-1}$ at -20 °C for HC is obtained without Na plating in HC. Furthermore, a $Na_{3.5}V_{2}(PO_{4})_{2}F_{3}$ cathode was prepared to couple with HC for investigating the low temperature behaviors of HC in full cell, which has been rarely studied.
evidence_chunks.paper_id: 0036_Lin 等 - 2019 - Exploring room- and low-temperature performance of hard carbon material in half and full Na-ion batt

evidence_chunks.chunk_id: 0036_Lin 等 - 2019 - Exploring room- and low-temperature performance of hard carbon material in half and full Na-ion batt::sec6::child10
evidence_chunks.content: One may still argue the accuracy of in situ XRD tests as the signal of metallic Na would not be detectable until the amount is accumulated to a specific value. In order to determine the Na plating capacity more punctually, ex situ XRD is conducted on HC electrodes in coin cells with capacity limitation from 200 to $300\mathrm{mAhg^{-1}}$ . The cells were cycled for 10 cycles to accumulate potential metallic Na. XRD patterns were collected at a discharged state. As shown in Figure S4, no Na peak is observed beneath the capacity of $250\mathrm{mAhg^{-1}}$ , and the Na signal appeared in $300\mathrm{mAhg^{-1}}$ sample. The Coulombic efficiency provides implications. The average Coulombic efficiency is around $97.4\%$ for the cells cycling at a limited capacity of $250\mathrm{mAhg^{-1}}$ or less. The value is close to $97.8\%$ when the cell is tested at room temperature with a cut-off voltage of 0 V. For the cell cycled at $300\mathrm{mAhg^{-1}}$ , the Coulombic efficiency decreases to only $95.3\%$ due to the Na plating/stripping.

## 配方筛选结果
获得文献支持的候选：candidate-1。

### 候选资料：candidate-1（通过筛选）
以下为候选记录中的组成，配制时须核对所引原文的比例基准与用量。
盐：NaClO4；浓度：1 mol L⁻¹；NaClO4：1 mol L⁻¹；溶剂：EC, PC；溶剂比例（体积）：EC=0.5, PC=0.5。
- 配方原文 [0036_Lin 等 - 2019 - Exploring room- and low-temperature performance of hard carbon material in half and full Na-ion batt::sec5::child0]：Coin cells (CR2032) were used to test the electrochemical performances. 1M NaClO $_{4}$ solution in a mixture of ethylene carbonate/propylene carbonate (EC/PC) (1:1 in volume) was applied as the electrolyte for the half cell and full cells. Two pieces of Whatman glass fibers soaked with the electrolyte were used as the separator between the positive and negative electrode. The HC electrode was prepared by casting a slurry of 90 wt% HC, 5 wt% conductive carbon black and 5 wt% polyvinylidene fluoride (PVDF) binder on copper foil. In companions, electrodes using carboxymethylcellulose sodium salt (CMC) and sodium alginate (NaAg) as the binder were also prepared. Typical loading mass of the HC electrode was around 1.5 mg cm $^{-2}$ . For the full cell, Na $_{3.5}$ V $_{2}$ (PO $_{4}$ ) $_{2}$ F $_{3}$ powders were mixed with 20% carbon SP for the preparation of positive electrodes. The weight ratio of the positive/negative electrodes was 2.5. The cells were galvanostatic charged/discharged with a LAND 2001 CT battery test system (Wuhan, China) under various voltage ranges and current rates. Electrochemical impedance spectroscopy (EIS) was carried out on a VMP system (Biologic S.A., Claix, France).

## 候选评估
### candidate-1
评估建议：The candidate electrolyte (1 M NaClO4 in EC/PC 1:1) is exactly the formulation used in the source to establish the reversible no-plating HC limit of 250 mAh g^-1 at -20 °C and to build and test the Na3.5V2(PO4)2F3||HC full cell, so it is an appropriate, literature-supported choice; the cited caveat is that the full cell still fades at -20 °C due to unstable SEI, which the source flags as an electrolyte-optimization direction rather than a contradiction of the candidate's validity.
任务要求与已有依据（模型语义判断，程序核验出处）：
- Electrolyte identity: 1 M NaClO4 in ethylene carbonate/propylene carbonate (EC/PC) 1:1 by volume, no additives.：The methods section states the electrolyte applied to both half and full cells is exactly 1 M NaClO4 in EC/PC (1:1 in volume), matching the candidate salt, concentration, solvents, ratio and absence of additives. [0036_Lin 等 - 2019 - Exploring room- and low-temperature performance of hard carbon material in half and full Na-ion batt::sec5::child0][0036_Lin 等 - 2019 - Exploring room- and low-temperature performance of hard carbon material in half and full Na-ion batt::sec5]
- Reversible, no-sodium-plating capacity limit for hard carbon at -20 °C.：The source reports that below 250 mAh g^-1 no Na peak is observed and above it plating begins, giving an average Coulombic efficiency of ~97.4% at the 250 mAh g^-1 limit versus only 95.3% at 300 mAh g^-1; hence 250 mAh g^-1 is regarded as the reversible and safe capacity limit for HC at -20 °C. [0036_Lin 等 - 2019 - Exploring room- and low-temperature performance of hard carbon material in half and full Na-ion batt::sec6::child11][0036_Lin 等 - 2019 - Exploring room- and low-temperature performance of hard carbon material in half and full Na-ion batt::sec6::child10]
- Applicability of the HC safe capacity limit to the Na3.5V2(PO4)2F3||hard-carbon full cell at -20 °C.：The source explicitly transfers the HC limit to the full cell: the safe capacity for HC at -20 °C is 250 mAh g^-1, about 80% of its room-temperature capacity and matching the cathode's 80.4% retention at -20 °C, so no change in cathode/anode mass ratio is needed. [0036_Lin 等 - 2019 - Exploring room- and low-temperature performance of hard carbon material in half and full Na-ion batt::sec6::child16][0036_Lin 等 - 2019 - Exploring room- and low-temperature performance of hard carbon material in half and full Na-ion batt::sec6::child17]
- The candidate electrolyte is used to assemble and evaluate the Na3.5V2(PO4)2F3||hard-carbon full cell at -20 °C.：The full cell with Na3.5V2(PO4)2F3 cathode and HC anode was built with this electrolyte and cycled at -20 °C, where significant capacity drop and SEI growth were observed, indicating the candidate supported the low-temperature full-cell characterization. [0036_Lin 等 - 2019 - Exploring room- and low-temperature performance of hard carbon material in half and full Na-ion batt::sec6::child17][0036_Lin 等 - 2019 - Exploring room- and low-temperature performance of hard carbon material in half and full Na-ion batt::sec6::child19]
文献与候选的关联：The electrolyte chunk (sec5) is the same formulation used across the half-cell and full-cell experiments in this paper; the HC no-plating limit chunks (sec6::child10/child11) report the in situ/ex situ XRD and Coulombic-efficiency evidence obtained in that electrolyte, and the full-cell chunks (sec6::child16/child17) report the matching Na3.5V2(PO4)2F3||HC cell also built with this same EC/PC-NaClO4 electrolyte, linking the electrolyte identity to the capacity-limit and full-cell results. [0036_Lin 等 - 2019 - Exploring room- and low-temperature performance of hard carbon material in half and full Na-ion batt::sec5::child0][0036_Lin 等 - 2019 - Exploring room- and low-temperature performance of hard carbon material in half and full Na-ion batt::sec6::child16]
### candidate-2
评估建议：The candidate electrolyte identity and its -20 C low-temperature operation on hard carbon are supported, but the sources cover only an HC half-cell and provide no Na3.5V2(PO4)2F3||HC full-cell or no-plating capacity-limit evidence, so no recommendation of the candidate for the target full-cell no-plating limit can be made; a held decision is warranted.
任务要求与已有依据（模型语义判断，程序核验出处）：
- Electrolyte identity: 1 M NaPF6 salt in THF solvent, no additives：The paper explicitly proposes a NaPF6/THF weakly solvating electrolyte and reports 1 M NaPF6/THF as the tested formulation, matching the candidate's salt, solvent and concentration. [0062_Tang 等 - 2022 - ElectrodeElectrolyte Interfacial Chemistry Modulation for Ultra-High Rate Sodium-Ion Batteries::sec2::child4][0062_Tang 等 - 2022 - ElectrodeElectrolyte Interfacial Chemistry Modulation for Ultra-High Rate Sodium-Ion Batteries::sec3::child19]
- Operation at low temperature of -20 C：The HC electrode in 1 M NaPF6/THF is reported to retain capacity and cycle stably at -20 C, directly supporting the candidate electrolyte's low-temperature function. [0062_Tang 等 - 2022 - ElectrodeElectrolyte Interfacial Chemistry Modulation for Ultra-High Rate Sodium-Ion Batteries::sec3::child19][0062_Tang 等 - 2022 - ElectrodeElectrolyte Interfacial Chemistry Modulation for Ultra-High Rate Sodium-Ion Batteries::sec1::child0]
- Applicability to a Na3.5V2(PO4)2F3||hard-carbon sodium-ion full cell：The sources only study a commercial hard carbon anode (half-cell, Na storage in HC) in NaPF6/THF; no Na3.5V2(PO4)2F3 cathode or full-cell assembly is reported, so the electrolyte is not evidenced for the target full cell. [0062_Tang 等 - 2022 - ElectrodeElectrolyte Interfacial Chemistry Modulation for Ultra-High Rate Sodium-Ion Batteries::sec3::child5]
- Determination of a reversible no-plating capacity limit (sodium plating threshold) for the full cell：None of the sources report sodium plating onset, plating threshold, or a no-plating reversible capacity limit; the paper reports HC rate/cycling capacity but no plating-limit measurement. [0062_Tang 等 - 2022 - ElectrodeElectrolyte Interfacial Chemistry Modulation for Ultra-High Rate Sodium-Ion Batteries::sec4::child0]
- Evidence that this electrolyte selection is appropriate for the negative-electrode interface at -20 C in the target cell：The weak-solvation/SEI benefit is demonstrated for the HC half-cell anode only; no transfer to the Na3.5V2(PO4)2F3||HC full-cell configuration is established in the sources. [0062_Tang 等 - 2022 - ElectrodeElectrolyte Interfacial Chemistry Modulation for Ultra-High Rate Sodium-Ion Batteries::sec3::child20]
文献与候选的关联：The candidate electrolyte (1 M NaPF6 in THF) matches the formulation tested in Tang 2022, where the commercial hard carbon anode shows high capacity and stability at -20 C. However, all reported electrochemistry is on a hard-carbon half-cell anode, not the Na3.5V2(PO4)2F3||hard-carbon full cell, and no sodium-plating-limit measurement is provided, so the association supports only the electrolyte's low-temperature anode function, not the target full-cell no-plating limit. [0062_Tang 等 - 2022 - ElectrodeElectrolyte Interfacial Chemistry Modulation for Ultra-High Rate Sodium-Ion Batteries::sec2::child4][0062_Tang 等 - 2022 - ElectrodeElectrolyte Interfacial Chemistry Modulation for Ultra-High Rate Sodium-Ion Batteries::sec3::child19][0062_Tang 等 - 2022 - ElectrodeElectrolyte Interfacial Chemistry Modulation for Ultra-High Rate Sodium-Ion Batteries::sec3::child5]
### candidate-3
评估建议：The 0.5 M NaPF6/DEGDME electrolyte is supported for low-temperature hard-carbon operation, but the target Na3.5V2(PO4)2F3||hard-carbon full cell and the reversible no-plating capacity limit at -20 °C are not addressed by the available evidence, so no recommendation can be issued without further acquisition.
任务要求与已有依据（模型语义判断，程序核验出处）：
- Electrolyte identity: 0.5 M NaPF6 dissolved in DEGDME (dilute ether electrolyte) as the salt/solvent system under evaluation.：The source explicitly defines 0.5-P-D as 0.5 M NaPF6 in DEGDME and characterizes its physicochemical and solvation properties, matching the candidate composition. [0013_Deng 等 - 2025 - Heterostructured Solid Electrolyte Interphase Enables Facilitated Kinetics for Low-Temperature Sodiu::sec2::child0][0013_Deng 等 - 2025 - Heterostructured Solid Electrolyte Interphase Enables Facilitated Kinetics for Low-Temperature Sodiu::sec2]
- Electrolyte must support low-temperature (-20 °C) sodium cell operation, including a hard-carbon anode.：HC||Na half cells with 0.5-P-D deliver 251 mAh g^-1 at -20 °C, and the electrolyte retains 0.45 mS cm^-1 at -50 °C, directly showing low-temperature functionality with a hard-carbon electrode. [0013_Deng 等 - 2025 - Heterostructured Solid Electrolyte Interphase Enables Facilitated Kinetics for Low-Temperature Sodiu::sec3::child0][0013_Deng 等 - 2025 - Heterostructured Solid Electrolyte Interphase Enables Facilitated Kinetics for Low-Temperature Sodiu::sec2::child0]
- Target full-cell chemistry must use a Na3.5V2(PO4)2F3 cathode paired with hard carbon and operate at -20 °C.：The full cell demonstrated with 0.5-P-D uses a Na0.85Li0.12Ni0.22Mn0.66O2 (NLNMO) cathode, not the target Na3.5V2(PO4)2F3, so there is no evidence for this specific cathode/full-cell pairing. [0013_Deng 等 - 2025 - Heterostructured Solid Electrolyte Interphase Enables Facilitated Kinetics for Low-Temperature Sodiu::sec3::child3]
- A reversible no-plating capacity limit at -20 °C must be established or bounded for the target full cell.：None of the provided chunks report sodium-plating or no-plating capacity limits; cycling and capacity data are given but the plating threshold is never measured or discussed. 
- Electrolyte should contain no additives.：The candidate is additive-free, but the source does not enumerate or exclude additives for the 0.5-P-D electrolyte, so additive status cannot be confirmed. 
文献与候选的关联：The 0.5-P-D electrolyte's low-temperature performance is established in HC||Na half cells at -20 °C and carried into a NLNMO||HC full cell, where 0.5-P-D retains 85 mAh g^-1 at -20 °C; this transfer is within the paper's own electrolyte formulation, but the full-cell cathode is NLNMO rather than the target Na3.5V2(PO4)2F3, so the half-cell-to-target-full-cell association for the requested chemistry is not established. [0013_Deng 等 - 2025 - Heterostructured Solid Electrolyte Interphase Enables Facilitated Kinetics for Low-Temperature Sodiu::sec3::child3][0013_Deng 等 - 2025 - Heterostructured Solid Electrolyte Interphase Enables Facilitated Kinetics for Low-Temperature Sodiu::sec2::child0]
### candidate-4
评估建议：Candidate-4's salt/solvent composition exactly matches the dual-anion ether electrolyte reported for NVPF||hard-carbon full cells with low-temperature capability; the electrolyte selection is literature-supported, while the -20 C no-plating capacity limit remains to be acquired by measurement rather than being contradicted by the sources.
任务要求与已有依据（模型语义判断，程序核验出处）：
- Electrolyte is a dual-anion ether system of 0.8 M NaPF6 + 0.2 M NaBF4 (1.0 M total) in a glyme solvent (DEGDME)：The methods section states the dual-anion regulated electrolyte consists of 0.8 M NaPF6 and 0.2 M NaBF4 in diethyleneglycol dimethyl ether, matching the candidate's salts and total concentration. [0023_Hu 等 - 2024 - Dual-anion ether electrolyte enables stable high-voltage Na3V2PO42F3 cathode under wide temperatur::sec7::child0]
- Electrolyte is paired with a Na3V2(PO4)2F3-type cathode：The same source reports electrodes and full cells built from HM-NVPF@CN (Na3V2(PO4)2F3-type fluorophosphate) cathode; the source composition is Na3V2(PO4)2F3 while the question writes Na3.5V2(PO4)2F3, so the identity is close but stoichiometry is not confirmed as exactly the same phase. [0023_Hu 等 - 2024 - Dual-anion ether electrolyte enables stable high-voltage Na3V2PO42F3 cathode under wide temperatur::sec7::child0]
- Electrolyte is compatible with a hard-carbon anode in a full cell：The source explicitly assembles the full cell using the HM-NVPF@CN cathode and a hard carbon (HC) anode, pre-cycled to form a stable interface, so the electrolyte is used in the target cathode||hard-carbon configuration. [0023_Hu 等 - 2024 - Dual-anion ether electrolyte enables stable high-voltage Na3V2PO42F3 cathode under wide temperatur::sec7::child0]
- Demonstrated low-temperature operation at -20 C for this electrolyte/cell：The highlights report outstanding low-temperature performance at -25 C for the optimized electrode and full-cell cyclability at -10, 25 and 60 C; no measurement at -20 C is reported, and the -25 C claim is for the electrode rather than the full cell at -20 C. [0023_Hu 等 - 2024 - Dual-anion ether electrolyte enables stable high-voltage Na3V2PO42F3 cathode under wide temperatur::sec1::child0]
- Reversible no-plating capacity limit at -20 C for the full cell：None of the supplied chunks reports a plating-limited reversible capacity or any sodium-plating threshold at -20 C for this chemistry; the sources describe CEI formation, cycling and low-temperature performance but not a no-plating capacity limit. [0023_Hu 等 - 2024 - Dual-anion ether electrolyte enables stable high-voltage Na3V2PO42F3 cathode under wide temperatur::sec1::child0]
文献与候选的关联：The cited methods chunk links the candidate electrolyte identity (0.8 M NaPF6 + 0.2 M NaBF4 in diethyleneglycol dimethyl ether) to the actual cell build: HM-NVPF@CN cathode, hard-carbon anode pre-cycled to stabilize the interface, CR2032 coin cells — establishing that this electrolyte family was tested in an NVPF||hard-carbon full cell, though at the temperatures reported (-25 C electrode; -10/25/60 C full cell) rather than -20 C. [0023_Hu 等 - 2024 - Dual-anion ether electrolyte enables stable high-voltage Na3V2PO42F3 cathode under wide temperatur::sec7::child0]
### candidate-5
评估建议：候选电解质在化学组成上等同于文献中经低温验证的 NDT 配方，并有硬碳负极在 -20 °C 的直接数据；但原问题要求的 Na3.5V2(PO4)2F3 正极适配与 -20 °C 无析钠可逆容量上限均无来源证据，且本次未执行任何计算，故暂不推荐，建议补充针对目标正极/无析镀判据的证据或计算。
任务要求与已有依据（模型语义判断，程序核验出处）：
- 电解质盐应为 NaPF6：候选指定 NaPF6；原文明确以 NaPF6 作为代表性盐搭配 SS–WS 醚溶剂混合物。 [0073_Yang 等 - 2023 - Entropy-Driven Solvation toward Low-Temperature Sodium-Ion Batteries with Temperature-Adaptive Featu::sec2::child1]
- 盐浓度应为 1.0 mol/L：原文明确最优配方为 1.0 M NaPF6 溶于 DIG 与 THF（体积比 2:8，记为 NDT），与候选 1.0 M 一致。 [0073_Yang 等 - 2023 - Entropy-Driven Solvation toward Low-Temperature Sodium-Ion Batteries with Temperature-Adaptive Featu::sec2::child1]
- 溶剂应为 DIG 与 THF，且体积比为 DIG:THF = 2:8：原文将最优配方定义为 1.0 M NaPF6 溶于 DIG 和 THF，体积比 2:8（NDT），与候选 DIG 0.2 / THF 0.8（体积基准）完全对应。 [0073_Yang 等 - 2023 - Entropy-Driven Solvation toward Low-Temperature Sodium-Ion Batteries with Temperature-Adaptive Featu::sec2::child1]
- 电解质需支持硬碳负极在 -20 °C 下工作：原文报告 NDT 中硬碳在 -20 °C 的容量保持率（平台区 99.8%，整体 92.8%），说明该候选在 -20 °C 下与硬碳负极兼容。 [0073_Yang 等 - 2023 - Entropy-Driven Solvation toward Low-Temperature Sodium-Ion Batteries with Temperature-Adaptive Featu::sec4::child8][0073_Yang 等 - 2023 - Entropy-Driven Solvation toward Low-Temperature Sodium-Ion Batteries with Temperature-Adaptive Featu::sec4::child4]
- 需有 Na3.5V2(PO4)2F3 正极在 -20 °C 全电池中的适配证据：原文全电池使用 NNCM（P2 层状氧化物）正极，而非 Na3.5V2(PO4)2F3；未提供该正极或 NVPF 型正极的任何数据，无法据此支持目标正极。 [0073_Yang 等 - 2023 - Entropy-Driven Solvation toward Low-Temperature Sodium-Ion Batteries with Temperature-Adaptive Featu::sec5]
- 需确定 -20 °C 下可逆且无析钠（no-plating）的容量上限：所有来源均未报告析钠/无析镀判据或对应的可逆容量上限，仅给出容量保持率与循环稳定性，无法回答该定量要求。 
文献与候选的关联：候选组成（1.0 M NaPF6，DIG:THF 体积比 0.2:0.8）与原文 NDT 电解液（1.0 M NaPF6，DIG/THF 体积比 2:8）配方一致，可视为同一配方；但原文实验体系为硬碳||Na 半电池及 NNCM||硬碳全电池，正极并非 Na3.5V2(PO4)2F3，故只能建立“该醚类电解液在低温硬碳体系可用”的有限关联，不能外推到目标 NVPF 正极全电池或 no-plating 容量上限。 [0073_Yang 等 - 2023 - Entropy-Driven Solvation toward Low-Temperature Sodium-Ion Batteries with Temperature-Adaptive Featu::sec2::child1][0073_Yang 等 - 2023 - Entropy-Driven Solvation toward Low-Temperature Sodium-Ion Batteries with Temperature-Adaptive Featu::sec4::child8][0073_Yang 等 - 2023 - Entropy-Driven Solvation toward Low-Temperature Sodium-Ion Batteries with Temperature-Adaptive Featu::sec5]
### candidate-6
评估建议：NaDFOB-G2 (1 M, additive-free) is directly supported as a viable low-temperature electrolyte and is compatible with NVP-family cathodes, so the electrolyte selection portion is partly supported. However, the core target quantity (reversible no-plating capacity limit for Na3.5V2(PO4)2F3||hard-carbon at -20 C) is unaddressed, no recorded_tool_predictions were produced, and hard-carbon compatibility is flagged as problematic; therefore a hold is warranted pending direct full-cell/no-plating evidence.
任务要求与已有依据（模型语义判断，程序核验出处）：
- Electrolyte salt identity: NaDFOB as standalone salt：The paper reports NaDFOB used as a solo/standalone electrolyte salt with good compatibility, matching the candidate's NaDFOB salt. [0070_Xia 等 - 2025 - Sodium-DifluorooxalatoBorate-Based Electrolytes for Long-Term Cycle Life and Enhanced Low-Temperat::sec1::child1][0070_Xia 等 - 2025 - Sodium-DifluorooxalatoBorate-Based Electrolytes for Long-Term Cycle Life and Enhanced Low-Temperat::sec1::child3]
- Solvent identity: G2 (diethylene glycol dimethyl ether / diglyme)：The paper explicitly describes NaDFOB-diethylene glycol dimethyl ether (G2) electrolyte and uses 1 M NaDFOB-G2 in characterization and cells. [0070_Xia 等 - 2025 - Sodium-DifluorooxalatoBorate-Based Electrolytes for Long-Term Cycle Life and Enhanced Low-Temperat::sec1::child3][0070_Xia 等 - 2025 - Sodium-DifluorooxalatoBorate-Based Electrolytes for Long-Term Cycle Life and Enhanced Low-Temperat::sec2::child2]
- Salt concentration: 1.0 M NaDFOB：The paper states the 1 M NaDFOB-G2 electrolyte was chosen for subsequent characterization, matching the candidate's 1.0 M value. [0070_Xia 等 - 2025 - Sodium-DifluorooxalatoBorate-Based Electrolytes for Long-Term Cycle Life and Enhanced Low-Temperat::sec2::child2]
- No additives required (no film-forming additives)：The paper notes NaDFOB has its own film-forming characteristics with no need for film-forming additives, consistent with the candidate's empty additive list. [0070_Xia 等 - 2025 - Sodium-DifluorooxalatoBorate-Based Electrolytes for Long-Term Cycle Life and Enhanced Low-Temperat::sec1::child1]
- Low-temperature (-20 C) performance with NaDFOB-G2：The NFPP electrode with NaDFOB-G2 shows 92.7% capacity retention at -20 C versus 25 C, so the electrolyte itself has documented -20 C operation, though on NFPP rather than the target cathode. [0070_Xia 等 - 2025 - Sodium-DifluorooxalatoBorate-Based Electrolytes for Long-Term Cycle Life and Enhanced Low-Temperat::sec2::child8]
- Compatibility with the target cathode Na3.5V2(PO4)2F3：The paper only states Na3V2(PO4)2F3 electrodes show high cycling stability over 200 cycles (Figures S8/S9); this is a close but not identical composition and is not tested at -20 C or in full cell form, so candidate-specific low-temperature cathode support is missing. [0070_Xia 等 - 2025 - Sodium-DifluorooxalatoBorate-Based Electrolytes for Long-Term Cycle Life and Enhanced Low-Temperat::sec2::child8]
- Full cell configuration: Na3.5V2(PO4)2F3||hard-carbon：The reported full cells are HC//NFPP coin and pouch cells, not HC//Na3V2(PO4)2F3; no data couples the target cathode with hard carbon full cell using this electrolyte. [0070_Xia 等 - 2025 - Sodium-DifluorooxalatoBorate-Based Electrolytes for Long-Term Cycle Life and Enhanced Low-Temperat::sec2::child8][0070_Xia 等 - 2025 - Sodium-DifluorooxalatoBorate-Based Electrolytes for Long-Term Cycle Life and Enhanced Low-Temperat::sec1::child3]
- Reversible no-plating (Na plating/dendrite-free) capacity limit at -20 C：No source reports a no-plating capacity limit or plating onset for hard carbon at -20 C; the paper actually notes the HC electrode has large overpotential and small capacity, indicating an unresolved anode limitation rather than a validated no-plating window. [0070_Xia 等 - 2025 - Sodium-DifluorooxalatoBorate-Based Electrolytes for Long-Term Cycle Life and Enhanced Low-Temperat::sec2::child8]
- Hard-carbon anode compatibility with NaDFOB-G2：The paper reports the HC electrode shows large room-temperature overpotential and small capacity, attributed to thick SEI/polarization; this flags a compatibility concern rather than confirmation of good HC performance. [0070_Xia 等 - 2025 - Sodium-DifluorooxalatoBorate-Based Electrolytes for Long-Term Cycle Life and Enhanced Low-Temperat::sec2::child8]
文献与候选的关联：The NaDFOB-G2 low-temperature (-20 C, 92.7% retention) and Na3V2(PO4)2F3 cycling-stability results come from half-cell/electrode tests (NFPP and NVP-based electrodes), whereas the full cell reported is HC//NFPP; the paper notes HC's large overpotential and small capacity. Thus the low-temperature electrolyte behavior is established, but it is not transferred by the authors to the target Na3.5V2(PO4)2F3||HC full cell, and no no-plating limit is measured. [0070_Xia 等 - 2025 - Sodium-DifluorooxalatoBorate-Based Electrolytes for Long-Term Cycle Life and Enhanced Low-Temperat::sec2::child8][0070_Xia 等 - 2025 - Sodium-DifluorooxalatoBorate-Based Electrolytes for Long-Term Cycle Life and Enhanced Low-Temperat::sec1::child3]
### candidate-7
评估建议：NaPF6 in DEGDME is a documented electrolyte, but no source addresses the Na3.5V2(PO4)2F3||hard-carbon full cell at -20 C or a reversible no-plating capacity limit, and no current-task computations were recorded; the evidence is insufficient to recommend and should be held pending targeted evidence.
任务要求与已有依据（模型语义判断，程序核验出处）：
- Electrolyte must use NaPF6 salt：Kang's group used NaPF6 as the salt in glyme solvents including DEGDME, establishing NaPF6's use in this solvent family; the carbonate table also lists 1 M NaPF6 formulations. [0150_aenm202000093pdf::sec5::child1][0150_aenm202000093pdf::sec4::child9]
- Electrolyte solvent must be DEGDME：The source states DEGDME was among the glymes evaluated and that NaPF6 in DEGDME was selected to realize a full cell, directly documenting this solvent/salt pair. [0150_aenm202000093pdf::sec5::child1]
- Electrolyte must support a Na3.5V2(PO4)2F3 cathode and hard-carbon anode full cell：The NaPF6/DEGDME full cell in the source paired a Na1.5VPO4.8F0.7 cathode with graphite (glyme intercalation), not Na3.5V2(PO4)2F3 against hard carbon; the carbonate table reports Na/Na3V2(PO4)2F3 but in EC:PC-based electrolytes, so neither establishes this specific cell configuration. [0150_aenm202000093pdf::sec5::child1][0150_aenm202000093pdf::sec4::child9]
- Operation at -20 C (low-temperature full-cell performance)：The source only reports room-temperature ionic conductivities and room-temperature cycling/rate capability; no low-temperature (-20 C) data for this electrolyte or cell is given. [0150_aenm202000093pdf::sec5::child1][0150_aenm202000093pdf::sec4::child9]
- Determination of a reversible no-plating capacity limit：No source reports a plating/no-plating threshold or reversible capacity limit for this electrolyte or full cell; the closest performance numbers (45 mAh g-1, 120 mAh g-1) are discharge capacities, not a no-plating limit. [0150_aenm202000093pdf::sec5::child1][0150_aenm202000093pdf::sec4::child9]
文献与候选的关联：The only full-cell association in the sources is NaPF6/DEGDME with a Na1.5VPO4.8F0.7 cathode and graphite, and the table's Na3V2(PO4)2F3 entry uses a carbonate electrolyte; neither experiment links the candidate electrolyte to the target Na3.5V2(PO4)2F3||hard-carbon cell, so no transferable experimental association exists. [0150_aenm202000093pdf::sec5::child1][0150_aenm202000093pdf::sec4::child9]
### candidate-8
评估建议：The candidate's salt, concentration, solvent ratio and additive are individually supported by the literature, but the core task requirements - reversible no-plating capacity limit and operation at -20 C for the Na3.5V2(PO4)2F3||hard-carbon full cell - are unaddressed by the provided sources, and no computations were performed. The evidence is insufficient to recommend the candidate, so the decision is held.
任务要求与已有依据（模型语义判断，程序核验出处）：
- Electrolyte salt is NaPF6 as the main/primary sodium salt：The source states NaPF6 was evaluated among sodium salts and proven to have the best comprehensive performance including high solubility, high thermal stability and optimized orbital energy level, supporting NaPF6 as a suitable main salt. [0002_Cai 等 - 2024 - A dual-functional electrolyte additive for stabilizing the solid electrolyte interphase and solvatio::sec3::child1]
- Salt concentration 0.8 mol/L NaPF6：The source's ECC formulation is explicitly given as 0.8 M NaPF6 in EC/PC/EMC, matching the candidate's 0.8 M NaPF6 concentration. [0002_Cai 等 - 2024 - A dual-functional electrolyte additive for stabilizing the solid electrolyte interphase and solvatio::sec7::child9]
- Solvent composition EC/PC/EMC with PC as the dominant component (ratios ~1:4:1)：The source describes ECC electrolyte with EC/PC/EMC = 0.5:2:0.5 (i.e., 1:4:1), which is equivalent to the candidate's EC:PC:EMC = 0.1667:0.6667:0.1667; EC is partially replaced by PC to obtain better cycle performance, consistent with the candidate's PC-rich ratio. [0002_Cai 等 - 2024 - A dual-functional electrolyte additive for stabilizing the solid electrolyte interphase and solvatio::sec7::child9]
- NaDFP additive present：The source repeatedly evaluates a NaDFP dual-functional additive, showing cells with NaDFP exhibit improved capacity retention and less anodic decomposition, supporting NaDFP as the additive identified in the candidate. [0002_Cai 等 - 2024 - A dual-functional electrolyte additive for stabilizing the solid electrolyte interphase and solvatio::sec7::child9]
- Evidence for low-temperature (-20 C) operation of the candidate electrolyte：The sources only report measurements at elevated temperatures (60 C shelving/cycling, 45 C ICP-OES); no low-temperature or -20 C data are provided, so the candidate's low-temperature suitability is not established from the literature. [0002_Cai 等 - 2024 - A dual-functional electrolyte additive for stabilizing the solid electrolyte interphase and solvatio::sec7::child9]
- Reversible no-plating capacity limit determined for the target full cell：No source reports a no-plating (sodium plating threshold) capacity limit, nor any plating/reversibility measurement, so this target metric is unaddressed. 
- Full cell configuration Na3.5V2(PO4)2F3||hard-carbon：The sources address NFM cathodes with hard-carbon anodes; the Na3.5V2(PO4)2F3 cathode of the target cell is not studied, so evidence does not cover the target full cell identity. [0002_Cai 等 - 2024 - A dual-functional electrolyte additive for stabilizing the solid electrolyte interphase and solvatio::sec7::child9]
文献与候选的关联：The candidate electrolyte composition (0.8 M NaPF6, EC/PC/EMC 1:4:1, NaDFP) matches the ECC electrolyte in Cai 2024, so the composition itself is associated with reported high-temperature (60/45 C) storage and cycling improvements and reduced transition-metal dissolution on hard carbon. source_refs.paper_id: 0036_Lin 等 - 2019 - Exploring room- and low-temperature performance of hard carbon material in half and full Na-ion batt
source_refs.raw_quote: Coin cells (CR2032) were used to test the electrochemical performances. 1M NaClO $_{4}$ solution in a mixture of ethylene carbonate/propylene carbonate (EC/PC) (1:1 in volume) was applied as the electrolyte for the half cell and full cells. Two pieces of Whatman glass fibers soaked with the electrolyte were used as the separator between the positive and negative electrode. The HC electrode was prepared by casting a slurry of 90 wt% HC, 5 wt% conductive carbon black and 5 wt% polyvinylidene fluoride (PVDF) binder on copper foil. In companions, electrodes using carboxymethylcellulose sodium salt (CMC) and sodium alginate (NaAg) as the binder were also prepared. Typical loading mass of the HC electrode was around 1.5 mg cm $^{-2}$ . For the full cell, Na $_{3.5}$ V $_{2}$ (PO $_{4}$ ) $_{2}$ F $_{3}$ powders were mixed with 20% carbon SP for the preparation of positive electrodes. The weight ratio of the positive/negative electrodes was 2.5. The cells were galvanostatic charged/discharged with a LAND 2001 CT battery test system (Wuhan, China) under various voltage ranges and current rates. Electrochemical impedance spectroscopy (EIS) was carried out on a VMP system (Biologic S.A., Claix, France).

source_refs.chunk_id: 0036_Lin 等 - 2019 - Exploring room- and low-temperature performance of hard carbon material in half and full Na-ion batt::sec2::child2
source_refs.paper_id: 0036_Lin 等 - 2019 - Exploring room- and low-temperature performance of hard carbon material in half and full Na-ion batt
source_refs.raw_quote: In view of this, there are few studies for low temperature NIBs using hard carbon as the anode. Instead, more attention is attracted to the alloy or carbon/alloy composite for their adequate capacity of around 100 mAh g $^{-1}$ at low temperatures, such as Ti-based metal oxides, $^{[16,17]}$ , Se/graphene $^{[18]}$ and Sb/CNT $^{[19]}$ composites. However, these anode materials are accompanied by the high average voltage, which is detrimental to the energy density of the full cell. Previous work indicates that the capacity of hard carbon may be fully utilized by lowering the cut-off potential to below 0 V. $^{[20]}$ It indeed allows a high capacity of 265 mAh g $^{-1}$ at -15 °C, $^{[21]}$ although the possibility of Na plating requires prudent investigation. In this work, the calcination protocol of synthesizing HC from biomass waste is systematically explored. It shows a significant dependence of the performance on the heat treatment processes. The optimized HC was then evaluated at both the room and low-temperature. Assisted with the in situ and ex situ XRD, the possibility of Na metal plating is thoroughly examined. A safe and reversible capacity of 250 mAh g $^{-1}$ at -20 °C for HC is obtained without Na plating in HC. Furthermore, a $Na_{3.5}V_{2}(PO_{4})_{2}F_{3}$ cathode was prepared to couple with HC for investigating the low temperature behaviors of HC in full cell, which has been rarely studied.

source_refs.raw_quote: One may still argue the accuracy of in situ XRD tests as the signal of metallic Na would not be detectable until the amount is accumulated to a specific value. In order to determine the Na plating capacity more punctually, ex situ XRD is conducted on HC electrodes in coin cells with capacity limitation from 200 to $300\mathrm{mAhg^{-1}}$ . The cells were cycled for 10 cycles to accumulate potential metallic Na. XRD patterns were collected at a discharged state. As shown in Figure S4, no Na peak is observed beneath the capacity of $250\mathrm{mAhg^{-1}}$ , and the Na signal appeared in $300\mathrm{mAhg^{-1}}$ sample. The Coulombic efficiency provides implications. The average Coulombic efficiency is around $97.4\%$ for the cells cycling at a limited capacity of $250\mathrm{mAhg^{-1}}$ or less. The value is close to $97.8\%$ when the cell is tested at room temperature with a cut-off voltage of 0 V. For the cell cycled at $300\mathrm{mAhg^{-1}}$ , the Coulombic efficiency decreases to only $95.3\%$ due to the Na plating/stripping.

Moreover, in situ Raman is adopted to investigate the ion storage behavior of HC at low temperature, and optical images were taken concomitantly. The optical images in Figure S6 clearly indicate the formation of Na metal at the capacity of $350\ mAh\ g^{-1}$ . Sodium dendrite could be recognized at the capacity of $450\ mAh\ g^{-1}$ .

source_refs.raw_quote: The voltage profiles of $\mathrm{Na}_{3.5}\mathrm{V}_{2}(\mathrm{PO}_{4})_{2}\mathrm{F}_{3}/\mathrm{HC}$ full cell consists of a plateau at 4.1 V and sloping regime between 3.6-2.5 V, contributing to an accumulative capacity of 306 mAh g $^{-1}$ (based on the mass of anode). The energy density is calculated to be 310 Wh kg $^{-1}$ based on the total weight of cathode and anode, along with an average discharge potential of 3.62 V. A stable cyclic performance similar to that in half-cell is achieved at $25^{\circ}$ C, as indicated by full cell F1 in Figure 5b. Ulteriorly, we tested the behavior of full cell under low temperature. Firstly, the performance of $\mathrm{Na}_{3.5}\mathrm{V}_{2}(\mathrm{PO}_{4})_{2}\mathrm{F}_{3}$ half-cell at 0°C and -20°C are measured and given in Figure S7a and S7b. The reversible capacity decreases with lowering the temperature. It maintains 93.2% and 80.4% of the capacity at room temperature for testing at 0°C and -20°C, respectively. Nevertheless, cyclic stability is kept. It is worthwhile to mention that the safe capacity for HC working at -20°C is 250 mAh g $^{-1}$ , which is also around 80% of its capacity at room temperature. Therefore, there is no need to change the mass ratio of the cathode and anode in the full cell for operating at low temperature.

source_refs.raw_quote: Therefore, there is no need to change the mass ratio of the cathode and anode in the full cell for operating at low temperature. As expected, the $\mathrm{Na}_{3.5}\mathrm{V}_{2}(\mathrm{PO}_{4})_{2}\mathrm{F}_{3}/\mathrm{HC}$ full cell also demonstrates a capacity reduction at 0 °C in the first several cycles and reaches stable capacity retention of 244 mAh g $^{-1}$ (F2 in Figure 5b). However, when the full cell was charged/discharged at -20°C, a significant drop in capacity is observed, particularly during the first 5 cycles. It may lie in the increased resistance on the anode side as reflected by EIS. The dynamic property of $\mathrm{Na}_{3.5}\mathrm{V}_{2}(\mathrm{PO}_{4})_{2}\mathrm{F}_{3}/\mathrm{HC}$ at different temperatures is also evaluated using galvanostatic intermittent titration technique (GITT), as indicated in Figure 5c. From the calculation, the diffusion coefficient of Na-ions ( $D_{Na}^{+}$ ) at 25°C is in the range of $10^{-9}$ to $10^{-10}$ cm $^{2}$ s $^{-1}$ . The value is only slightly decreased at 0°C. In sharp contrast, the $D_{Na}^{+}$ value is about one magnitude lower at -25 °C than that at 25°C. The slow $Na^{+}$ diffusion is in agreement with the EIS results that the thicker SEI film would affect the ion diffusion. After testing at $-20^{\circ}C$ for 10 cycles, the same cell (F3) was put back to $25^{\circ}C$ and its capacity gradually recovered and regained ca. 82% of the capacity at $25^{\circ}C$ .

source_refs.paper_id: 0062_Tang 等 - 2022 - ElectrodeElectrolyte Interfacial Chemistry Modulation for Ultra-High Rate Sodium-Ion Batteries
source_refs.raw_quote: This work aims to demonstrate the critical effect of electrode-electrolyte interfacial chemistry on the performance of a commercial hard carbon anode operating at the rate and temperature extremes. A new weakly solvating electrolyte (WSE) consisting of a cyclic ether (tetrahydrofuran, THF) as solvent and $\mathrm{NaPF_6}$ as the electrolyte salt was proposed to optimize the interfacial properties of anode/electrolyte. Surprisingly, the lower ion desolvation energy and homogeneous SEI are simultaneously achieved. Benefiting from the low $\mathrm{Na^{+}}$ desolvation energy and fast transport at the anode/electrolyte interface, the commercial hard carbon anode demonstrates ultra-high rate capability and remarkable low-temperature performance.

source_refs.chunk_id: 0062_Tang 等 - 2022 - ElectrodeElectrolyte Interfacial Chemistry Modulation for Ultra-High Rate Sodium-Ion Batteries::sec3::child19
source_refs.paper_id: 0062_Tang 等 - 2022 - ElectrodeElectrolyte Interfacial Chemistry Modulation for Ultra-High Rate Sodium-Ion Batteries
source_refs.raw_quote: It is well known that low-temperature performance is also significant for some special scenarios in practical applications. However, there are few reports on the low-temperature performance of the HC anode for SIBs. As previous studies have indicated that the solvation structure of the electrolyte defines the charge-transfer behavior at low temperature, $^{[13a]}$ the low-temperature performance of HC in THF-based electrolyte was further investigated. When the ambient temperature drops to $-5^{\circ}C$ (Figure 5a), the specific capacities of HC in 1 M NaPF $_{6}$ /THF electrolyte at 20 mA g $^{-1}$ and 5 Ag $^{-1}$ are 282 and 155 mAh g $^{-1}$ , respectively, indicating superior rate capability. Even at -20°C, a high capacity of 269 and 175 mAh g $^{-1}$ can be achieved at 20 mA g $^{-1}$ and 2 Ag $^{-1}$ , respectively. The charge-discharge profile in 1 M NaPF $_{6}$ /THF electrolyte (Figure 5b,c) still maintains a high low-plateau capacity at different densities, indicating favorable kinetics. Moreover, HC anode in 1 M NaPF $_{6}$ /THF electrolyte also possesses superior long-term cycling stability with a specific capacity of 203 mAh g $^{-1}$ over 1000 cycles at a large current density of 2 A g $^{-1}$ at -5°C (Figure 5d). Even at a lower temperature of -20°C, it still delivers high capacity retention up to 95% with a specific capacity of 181 mAh g $^{-1}$ over 1000 cycles (Figure 5e).
